UsageMetadata contains promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, toolUsePromptTokenCount, thoughtsTokenCount, cachedContentTokenCount, promptTokensDetails, cacheTokensDetails, candidatesTokensDetails, toolUsePromptTokensDetails, and trafficType. TrafficType values include ON_DEMAND, ON_DEMAND_PRIORITY, ON_DEMAND_FLEX, ON_DEMAND_OFF_PEAK, and PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT.
